about: About Founded in 1865 and located in the capital of Wales, Cardiff Metropolitan University delivers professionally recognised degrees, together with impactful research and innovation, in art and design, business and management, education and public services, sport and health sciences, and technologies and engineering. Whether students are lo​o​king for undergraduate​ or postgraduate study, Cardiff Metropolitan University is an excellent choice for international students choosing to study in the UK.​ The University has two campus locations; Llandaff and Cyncoed. Llandaff is the home of theCardiff School of Sport & Health Sciences (Llandaff), Cardiff School of Management, ​​​Cardiff School of Technologies and the ​​​Cardiff School of Art & Design​ while Cyncoed is home to the Cardiff School of Education & Social Policy and the Cardiff School of Sport & Health Sciences. Cardiff Metropolitan is a collaborative and compassionate community, their values of creativity, diversity, freedom and innovation are lived through the behaviours of their staff and students; by their leadership, trust, courage and accountability to each other, and to their partners. The school is home to approximately 11,000 students, with over 1200 international students from more than 143 countries. International students are value​d and respected for the unique experiences and perspectives that they contribute to university life, enriching the study experience for all students. Why Cardiff Metropolitan University The Cardiff Met EDGE : The university works in partnership with students to instil the Cardiff Met EDGE - a series of Ethical, Digital, Global and Entrepreneurial skills to develop students' confidence, resilience and experiences that will them for life after university and through to employment. Reputation and Recognition : Rooted in Wales with an international reach, Cardiff Metropolitan University is a globally focused institution with a strong reputation for their work with industry and professions. As such, they were awarded the highly prestigious title of UK and Ireland University of the Year 2021 by the Times Higher Education. The award recognises Cardiff Met's achievements throughout the 2019/20 academic year and the ways in which the University has established itself as a progressive values-driven university with an excellent student experience, staff culture and impactful research and innovation. Cardiff Met has also been ranked as the best university in the UK for sustainability in People and Planet's Green League 2022/23. Cardiff Met Sport : Cardiff Met has established itself as one of the leading universities for student sport in the UK. The University offers excellent sports facilities and an extensive range of activities to cater to everyone from elite athletes to students, staff and the wider community. Show More

features.answer: Post Graduation Permit171 out of 171 programs are eligible for Post-Study Work Visa.Post-Study Work Visa will be open to all students, on Tier 4 visas, who are accepted onto a course in the 2020 intake or later. Once you have successfully completed a course of study at the undergraduate level or above at an approved UK Higher Education Provider you would be able to stay and work (in any sector or at any level) for a maximum of two years.The full details and requirements are yet to be announced by the UK Government, but will be updated here when made available.Co-op/Internship ParticipationCooperative education (or co-operative education) and internships are methods of combining classroom-based education with practical work experience. A cooperative education experience ("co-op"), provides academic credit for structured job experience. Co-ops are full-time, paid or unpaid positions. Internships may be full-time or part-time, paid or unpaid positions.Work While StudyingSee guidelines on working while studyinghere.Conditional Offer LetterAccommodationsCardiff Metropolitan University aims to provide a safe and secure environment for students living on campus, with friendly Halls staff available to provide support and help throughout their stay. Currently they have nearly 1000 study bedrooms located at the Cyncoed and  campuses. All bedrooms are mixed gender and inclusive of all utility bills, including electric, gas, water, internet, insurance, etc.In addition, Cardiff Met also allocates just over 1,100 private en-suite halls to students through nomination agreements with private halls located near to the campuses.There are two Cardiff Met-owned halls of residence which are conveniently located to accommodate students studying on any of the two campuses. Rooms at Plas Gwyn halls are allocated to students studying at the Llandaff Campus and rooms at Cyncoed halls are allocated to students studying at the Cyncoed Campus.ThePlas Gwyncampus is located in the small, pleasant cathedral 'city' of Llandaff, which is approximately two miles from Cardiff city centre and walking distance from the Llandaff Campus. All of the single study bedrooms are self-catered and have en suite bathroom facilities.Facilities for both halls include on site laundry, data room and communal TV room with vending machines. The halls are in close proximity to shopping, banking and other facilities and students can also take advantage of the sports and leisure facilities at the Llandaff campus as well as the extensive sports and recreational facilities located at the Cyncoed campus, including an indoor swimming pool, Students' Union bar/disco, indoor tennis centre and fitness suite.Please refer to theStudent Accommodationpage for more details.

about: About University of Lancashire - Preston Campus is right at the heart of the city. You'll find us minutes away from a vibrant shopping centre, attractions and nightlife. It’s home to a thriving international community of over 42,000 students and staff. Why University of Lancashire - Preston Mission : University is proud of their mission and they take it seriously. Since being founded as the Institution for the Diffusion of Knowledge in 1828, their educational ethos has brought life-changing learning to local people, this remains at the heart of their mission. University institution motto ‘Ex solo ad solem’ translates to ‘From the Earth to the Sun’. It means helping talented people from all walks of life to make the most of their potential. They create positive change in their students, staff, business partners and wider communities, enabling them to develop their full potential by providing excellent higher education, innovation and research.They are a proud civic anchor too, committed to adding social value and playing their role in the economic prosperity of the places in which they are based; sourcing products and services locally, boosting jobs and economic growth. There pride themselves on universally supporting their people, being actively liberating, inherently innovative and proudly spirited to face whatever life throws at us. These values are woven into the fabric of who they are and will always be. Values and initiatives : University of Lancashire - Preston values reflect who they are as a university and what they stand for. They define the things that are most important to us and nurture University's sense of shared purpose. Supporting their values and initiatives are a number of networks, creating positive change throughout their university, for their students, colleagues and the wider communities. Sustainability : The University is a Gold Tier University in the Green Universities Report 2023 (USwitch), highlighting University's commitment to sustainability. They have retained a 2:1 classification in the People & Planet University Green League 2023/24, where they also ranked first place in the North West for water reduction. The University is also one of just 13 universities worldwide to achieve a Bronze Carbon Literate Organisation status. Show More

about: About University of Westminster - a global university with London energy Since 1838, the University of Westminster has been helping students from all backgrounds to achieve their potential. And, with over 19,000 students from 160 different countries, University of Westminster is proud to be one of the most diverse universities in the UK. The university's courses are career-focused and often professionally accredited to give applicants practical skills and professional expertise they need for their future career. Across four campuses, including three in central London, students will be taught in world-class teaching facilities. The university's location gives students easy access to the city's financial centre, leading international employers and an endless choice of social and cultural attractions from music, restaurants and bars to theatres, libraries and world-class museums. The Marylebone Campus is within walking distance of Regent's Park and home to the Westminster Business School. It features the Westminster Boardroom, Bloomberg Financial Markets Suite, cutting-edge fabrication lab, exhibition space and an extensive library. From this site, the university offers undergraduate and postgraduate courses including: Accounting and Finance Business and Management Construction, Surveying and Real Estate Data Science and Informatics Economics Marketing Tourism and Events Management Transport and Logistics And Architecture, which belongs to the School of Architecture and Cities Why University of Westminster - Marylebone Excellent Location: With three campuses in central London and a creative hub in Harrow, north-west London, you'll study in one of the most culturally rich, vibrant cities in the world, which is regularly voted one of best places to be a student according to the QS Best Student Cities Ranking. Career-Building Opportunities: Leading national and multinational companies plus thousands of pioneering start-ups are based in London, making it a great place to meet potential employers, build your network and gain valuable experience to kick-start your career. Practical and professionally accredited courses: University of Westminster's courses are designed with input from industry and leading professional bodies to give students the skills employers need. Comprehensive Careers Support: Award-winning careers service provides advice, access to work placements and mentoring schemes. The university's team will help students find work after they graduate and will continue to support them for three years after graduation. State-of-the-art Facilities: The university's industry-standard facilities include recording studios, cutting-edge fabrication lab, science laboratories, film and television studios, extensive libraries and financial market suites. features.answer: Post Graduation Permit90 out of 90 programs are eligible for Post-Study Work Visa.Post-Study Work Visa will be open to all students, on Tier 4 visas, who are accepted onto a course in the 2020 intake or later. Once you have successfully completed a course of study at the undergraduate level or above at an approved UK Higher Education Provider you would be able to stay and work (in any sector or at any level) for a maximum of two years.The full details and requirements are yet to be announced by the UK Government, but will be updated here when made available.Co-op/Internship ParticipationCooperative education (or co-operative education) and internships are methods of combining classroom-based education with practical work experience. A cooperative education experience ("co-op"), provides academic credit for structured job experience. Co-ops are full-time, paid or unpaid positions. Internships may be full-time or part-time, paid or unpaid positions.Work While StudyingSee guidelines on working while studyinghere.Conditional Offer LetterEven if you do NOT meet our minimum English requirement (IELTS or TOEFL), you still can get conditionally accepted in the program of your choice with the condition of completing our English program prior to starting your chosen program.AccommodationsStudents need to plan their accommodations well in advance of their arrival as all accommodation options fill up quickly, well before the start of the semester.On-Campus residence accommodations are provided per discretion by the school.Off-Campus AccommodationsThe local area has a variety of off-campus rental housing options including single homes, duplexes, apartments and rooms for rent. Students wishing to live off-campus need to research availability on their own and should arrive well before the start of term to do so.HomestayThere are a wide variety of homestay options available, and our partners do their best to match students and hosts according to their interests and preferences. Homestay hosts include single people, young couples with children and pets, and older couples. All homestay accommodations have been inspected, and all adults in the home have completed a required criminal reference check.

about: About The University of Law is one of the UK's leading professional law schools, with an unrivalled reputation for innovation and excellence in legal learning. Their first-class global connections means they are uniquely placed to help aspiring lawyers, legal professionals and legal employers of all types achieve their ambitions. What really sets the University of Law apart from other universities is their guiding principle that future lawyers and business leaders should learn in a realistic, professional and contemporary context, with plenty of practical interactive engagement. That's why they keep their contact hours high and their teaching groups small. The University of Law's track record of excellence in learning and development has helped them establish worldwide connections within the legal and business industries. This is why many leading global law firms and businesses work exclusively with the University of Law to develop their people, and why employers of all types want to meet University of Law students. It’s why law schools and professional bodies around the world choose to enter into strategic alliances with the University of Law. The University of Law has a vast network in the legal industry and deliver legal training to 94 of the top 100 law firms, with exclusive relationships with 60 of the top UK law firms and many of the most prestigious US firms in the UK. Bristol is the South West’s commercial hub and a vibrant, student-friendly place to be. Its size enables it to remain friendly but also big enough to provide excellent employment opportunities. The city is known for its creative character, rich history and culture, including its role as the birthplace of world famous artist Banksy, whose artwork can be seen dotted around the city in public spaces. Bristol is close to the city centre, which has many independent cafes and restaurants, and is just a short walk from Bristol Temple Meads Train Station – a major transport hub in the area. It’s located in the heart of Bristol’s legal district, within easy reach of major law firms and chambers, meaning the campus benefits from strong links to local legal employers. At Bristol, the tutors and staff are dedicated to helping students achieve their education and career ambitions. Students who study Law will be able to benefit from their tutors’ experience as all of them are qualified lawyers. Students will also be allocated a personal tutor who is there to support them during their studies and help them access the school's additional support services. Why the University of Law Heritage : The University of Law is the largest provider of legal education in the UK, tracing their origins to 1876 with the formation of tutorial firm Gibson & Weldon, and in 2016, they opened their leading Business School. Networking : With an alumni network of over 71,000, graduates can stay connected, remain informed and take advantage of a wealth of specially negotiated privileges and discounts. The Alumni Network connects students to over 11,800 businesses and organisations worldwide, allowing them to tap into an incredible pool of alumni talent. Innovative and Contemporary Teaching Practices : All of the University of Law's courses – from their undergraduate law degrees to their diverse range of business courses and postgraduate programmes – are designed with a unique, varied and innovative learning approach proven to deliver self-reliant professionals who can compete in the fast-changing professional world. Focused on Employability : The school focuses exclusively on practice-based training and gives students access to expert Careers and Employability service database as soon as they accept their offer. Students also benefit from University of Law's pioneering and award-winning pro bono programmes, which allow them to gain valuable work experience by helping real clients from the local community. header.university_name: University of Chester - University Centre Shrewsbury

about: About With 15,000 students from 130 countries worldwide, The University of Chester provides a vibrant, diverse and safe home for international students. The university is one of the oldest higher education providers in the United Kingdom having recently celebrated its 180th year of teaching, starting off as a teacher training college back in 1839. Originally based on one campus in Chester, the university now offers more than 200 single and combined honour’s programmes across a number of specialist sites in Chester, Shrewsbury and Warrington. Courses have an emphasis on practical learning to enhance prospects via industry placements or overseas opportunities, ranging from five-weeks to one-year. Following more than 41,000 student reviews across 150 UK Universities, the University of Chester finished second in the best for international students' category at the 2020 WhatUni? Student Choice Awards. This national recognition, voted for by current international students, is testament to the university’s commitment to providing international students with the very best experience and support. Why University of Chester - University Centre Shrewsbury Facilities: The newly renovated Guildhall building is the main centre for teaching and learning. It provides fresh and open spaces for students in which they will find modern computer suites, lecture and seminar rooms, open-plan laboratories and a spacious library. There are a range of subject-specific facilities at the Guildhall building to ensure students have the most engaging learning experience possible, to allow them to put what they’re learning into practice. Student Life: Outside of the classroom students can relax in the student common room, lounge, fitness suite, courtyard, and on-site café; and Guildhall is conveniently located just a short walk from the town centre, allowing students to explore the picturesque streets alongside their studies. Distinctive Institution : The University of Chester and Shropshire Council have established University Centre Shrewsbury to increase students’ Higher Education prospects and offer a personalised and engaging student experience shaped to them. Since welcoming their first cohort in 2015, at the University Centre Shrewsbury they have strived to offer students a well-rounded and supportive university experience within the beautiful medieval town of Shrewsbury. about: About As a specialist postgraduate university located at the heart of the UK's Cambridge – Milton Keynes – Oxford arc, Cranfield University's world-class programmes, unrivalled facilities, close links with business, industry and governments, and international outlook all combine to attract students and teaching staff from around the globe. The result is a long track record of creating leaders and innovators in specialist areas of science, technology, engineering and management. Cranfield graduates are in demand and their association with the university brings benefits throughout their careers. Cranfield is of the top six research universities in the UK, home to many world-class, large-scale facilities which enhance teaching and research. It is the only university in Europe to have its own airport – the global research airport offers a unique environment for transformational research. The living laboratory is a testbed for transformative technologies and new approaches to deliver enhanced social, economic and environmental outcomes in urban, transport and infrastructure systems. Why Cranfield University: Connection to industry : Cranfield works closely with business, industry, and governments around the world. Through industry partnerships, applied research projects, and executive education and development programs, Cranfield currently works with over 1,500 companies and organisations. Academic excellence : Cranfield is a six-time winner of the Queen's Anniversary Prize for Further and Higher Education. It is ranked in the top ten UK universities for commercial research, consultancy, and professional development, and ranked by Times Higher Education as first in the UK for research income per academic in 2017. Small class sizes : Cranfield's staff-to-student ratio of 8:1 is one of the best of any university in the UK, giving students a hands-on, practical approach to the learning experience. World-class facilities : Built on a former RAF base, Cranfield is one of only a few universities in the world to own and run its own airport, maintaining an aerospace heritage stretching back more than 70 years. Many facilities are industry standard, used by other universities and serve as essential, front-line resources for the UK as a whole. These include the National Flying Laboratory Centre, the National Wind Tunnel facility, and the National Reference Centre for Soils. Show More

about: About For those looking for the bustle of city life without the hustle, beautiful Kingston upon Thames is the place to be. On the doorstep of the capital, Kingston is one of London’s safest boroughs and offers all the highlights of city living in a leafy, riverside location. Kingston upon Thames in Greater London is just 10 miles from the centre of the capital. The University has roots going back more than 120 years to the Kingston Technical Institute which opened in 1899. Kingston University takes great pride in the difference they make in the lives of their over 18,000 students and the wider community they serve. They are constantly striving to provide excellent services and continue to make a positive contribution to the economic, social, and cultural life of the borough. Why Kingston University London - Penrhyn Road Location: Kingston Upon Thames has an excellent public transportation system, with two mainline train stations, bus routes and major motorways nearby, making it easy to get around the city and country. Close to Kingston town centre, the Penrhyn Road campus is a lively central hub and buzzes with student activity day and night. Extracurricular Activities: There is no shortage of clubs, societies and volunteer organizations to join that bring people of common interests, faiths and ethnic backgrounds together. Facilities: Students from all campuses converge on this large central complex which is home to the students' union headquarters, the main gym and health centre. It is also the site of the University's new landmark building, Townhouse. The Tolworth Court sports ground is also a great place to play a wide range of sports, including but not limited to football, rugby, tennis, and more. Accommodation: The University offers international students a range of high quality halls to choose from, all of which have single-study bedrooms arranged in flats with self-catering kitchens. header.address: Bournemouth University, Talbot Campus, Fern Barrow, Poole

about: About Bournemouth University is an innovative and vibrant public university located in Bournemouth, Dorset, a coastal town famous for its seven-mile stretch of sandy beaches. The town of Bournemouth has a population of roughly 500,000 and is a thriving hub for several industries including the creative, financial, and tourism sectors. Bournemouth University boasts a strong student community with over 19,000 students and more than 2,600 international students. Bournemouth University offers students many innovative and industry-focused programs, with particular strengths in media and communication and technology. Students will benefit from close ties to industry and many of BU's programs offer industry accreditation or placements with over 1,500 industry partners. Talbot Campus is the main campus for Bournemouth University and hosts the main University buildings including the student union and the main library. It has had many recent updates (2017-2018) and is a self-contained campus located on the boundary of Bournemouth and Poole. Why Bournemouth University - Talbot Campus : Talbot Campus is the main campus for Bournemouth University, and has many of the flagship facilities including the Sir Michael Cobham Library, and the Student Centre. Economic Region : Bournemouth is home to UK's fastest growing digital economy, and one of the UK's largest financial centres outside of London. Facilities : Talbot Campus houses the main library and student union, alongside SportBU - a fully equipped sport centre and gym. Culture : Bournemouth is a cosmopolitan, student-friendly town with a relaxed, beach-side lifestyle. Bournemouth is home to AFC Bournemouth, one of England's newest Premiership football teams and BU's official sport partner. Show More

header.address: Brunel University, Russell Building, Kingston Lane, Uxbridge

about: About Brunel University London Pathway College is designed to meet the needs of students by offering world-class pathway programs leading to undergraduate and postgraduate degrees at Brunel University London. At undergraduate level, this pathway college offers University Foundation and First year University Studies for candidates who do not meet the direct entry criteria or hold high school qualifications that are not recognized. At postgraduate level, Brunel University London Pathway College provides the highly acclaimed Pre-Master's program leading to an excellent range of Brunel University London Master programs in business and management, computing, engineering & design and arts. Brunel University London Pathway College is located inside Brunel University London Campus, so students will experience university student life from day one. and they will have access to all of university facilities. Brunel University London Pathway College is there to support students for their future academic and professional careers. Brunel is a single site university where students can take part in a diverse range of clubs and societies for an action-packed social life. Everything is within a 10-minute walk - whether students are going to a class or for a coffee, whether they want a place to eat or a space to meet, it's all close by! Why Brunel University London Pathway College? Facilities and Safety: Located inside Brunel University London. Students are offered a safe, friendly and positive environment where they benefit from high-quality teaching, recreation and sporting facilities. Location: Campus is well-connected. Just a short walk away, the town of Uxbridge offers students everything they need to shop, entertain and socialize, with central London just a tube ride away. Employability : Students can develop a wide range of employability skills and improve their career prospects, with the help of the University's Professional Development service. Brunel’s careers service is rated the 5th best careers service in the country (Student Hut Survey, 2019). Pathways : All pathway programs offer smaller class sizes for greater individual attention, of up to 30 students per class. Placements : Over 95% of Brunel University London undergraduate courses offer a placement, giving students the opportunity to gain invaluable work experience. Show More

header.university_name: Coventry University (Part of Coventry University Group)

about: About Coventry University is a forward-looking, modern university with a proud tradition as a provider of high quality education and a focus on applied research. Students benefit from state-of-the-art equipment and facilities in all academic disciplines including health, design and engineering laboratories, and performing arts studios and computing centres. Students with international experience obtain higher starting salaries, develop the global skills employers require and achieve better career progression. The dedicated Centre for Global Engagement (CGE) offers a range of programmes and funding to assist students in widening their international experience including language classes, studying or working abroad, international fieldtrips, global research, cultural workshops, Summer Schools, leadership development or work experience in the UK. Why Coventry University Employability: Coventry University focus on increasing the employability of students and have a range of industry-leading initiatives to help prepare you for graduate employment. The Talent Team can help you to find work experience, join international field trips or study towards industry qualifications. And, unlike many universities, if you choose to undertake an optional work placement or study abroad year, you won’t be charged a tuition fee. Teaching: Coventry courses are dynamic, interactive and stimulating, designed to bring your subject to life. Location: Coventry is a vibrant and diverse student city, located in the centre of the UK and only 1 hour from London by train. The single-site campus is located at the heart of Coventry, so everything you need is within a few minutes’ walk. The city’s rich history and heritage sees world famous sites like Coventry Cathedral and St Mary’s Guildhall sit alongside exciting newer developments like Coventry Transport Museum, Fargo Village and a host of shops, restaurants, entertainment and nightlife venues. Student Experience: Awarded University of the Year for Student Experience 2019, the reputation of student experience at Coventry is based on a solid foundation of academic and welfare student support. There is a great Students’ Union too, with more than 55 sports clubs and 160 societies, so it is easy to spend time doing the things you enjoy. Top 15 UK University for 5 Years Running (The Guardian University Guide, 2016-2020) The University of Year for Student Experience (The Times & Sunday Times Good University Guide, 2019) Awarded 5 stars or teaching, employability, facilities, internationalisation and inclusiveness (QS Stars Rating System, 2019) Awarded Gold for outstanding Teaching and Learning (Teaching Excellence Framework) Show More

features.question: Off-Campus Accommodations
features.answer: Post Graduation Permit402 out of 402 programs are eligible for Post-Study Work Visa.Post-Study Work Visa will be open to all students, on Tier 4 visas, who are accepted onto a course in the 2020 intake or later. Once you have successfully completed a course of study at the undergraduate level or above at an approved UK Higher Education Provider you would be able to stay and work (in any sector or at any level) for a maximum of two years.The full details and requirements are yet to be announced by the UK Government, but will be updated here when made available.Co-op/Internship ParticipationCooperative education (or co-operative education) and internships are methods of combining classroom-based education with practical work experience. A cooperative education experience ("co-op"), provides academic credit for structured job experience. Co-ops are full-time, paid or unpaid positions. Internships may be full-time or part-time, paid or unpaid positions.Work While StudyingSee guidelines on working while studyinghere.Conditional Offer LetterEven if you do NOT meet our minimum English requirement (IELTS or TOEFL), you still can get conditionally accepted in the program of your choice with the condition of completing our English program prior to starting your chosen program.AccommodationsStudents wishing to live off-campus need to research availability on their own, and should arrive well before the start of term to do so.HOMESTAYThere are a wide variety of homestay options available, and our partner schools do their best to match students and hosts according to their interests and preferences. All homestay accommodations have been inspected, and all adults in the home have completed a required criminal reference check.

about: About At SOAS, we view the world through a different lens. Our expertise in the study of Africa, Asia and the Middle East shapes our understanding to tackle the global challenges of our time. Come to SOAS and join a welcoming, diverse, and close-knit community in central London. Here, we challenge perspectives, broach debate and empower our students to find solutions to the issues facing the world today. If you want to expand your horizons and develop a deeper understanding of the world, be part of SOAS: the world’s university. SOAS in Stats: 6th in the UK for employability (QS World University Rankings 2023) 2nd in the UK for International Faculty Top 30 in the UK (The Times Good University Guide 2023) 135+ countries represented across the student body 54% international students 87% of research ranked 'world leading or internationally excellent' (Research Excellence Framework 2021) Silver (Teaching Excellence Framework 2023) Top 50 in the world for internationalism (QS World University Rankings 2024) Why Choose SOAS, University of London Central London Campus: Located in leafy and cosmopolitan Bloomsbury, our central London campus is right at the centre of it all. Student Advice and Wellbeing: We pride ourselves on providing a welcoming and supportive environment for everyone and helping to make your SOAS experience fulfilling. Study Abroad: Study abroad for a year and enhance your SOAS degree. Explore our study abroad and exchange programmes for visiting and outgoing students, including more than 70 global destinations. Your Career: A SOAS education gives you a unique perspective on the world, providing you with the cultural insights and skills to make a difference where it matters most. Show More

features.question: Undergraduate halls | SOAS
features.answer: Post Graduation Permit307 out of 307 programs are eligible for Post-Study Work Visa.Post-Study Work Visa will be open to all students, on Tier 4 visas, who are accepted onto a course in the 2020 intake or later. Once you have successfully completed a course of study at the undergraduate level or above at an approved UK Higher Education Provider you would be able to stay and work (in any sector or at any level) for a maximum of two years.The full details and requirements are yet to be announced by the UK Government, but will be updated here when made available.Co-op/Internship ParticipationCooperative education (or co-operative education) and internships are methods of combining classroom-based education with practical work experience. A cooperative education experience ("co-op"), provides academic credit for structured job experience. Co-ops are full-time, paid or unpaid positions. Internships may be full-time or part-time, paid or unpaid positions.Work While StudyingSee guidelines on working while studyinghere.Conditional Offer LetterIf you have not yet taken an English language test (IELTS, PTE, TOEFL), you can still apply for your degree, but we will request evidence of English language requirements as part of your conditional offer letter. Please visit English language requirements | SOAS to check if you are eligible for an exemption: https://www.soas.ac.uk/english-language-requirementsAccommodationsLiving in central London is an unrivalled experience. SOAS offers a variety of housing options in locations that range from 5 minutes to 45 minutes travel to the SOAS campus in historic Bloomsbury.Our portfolio consists of halls of residence with 24-hour security and rooms in shared flats or houses.Find the perfect undergraduate halls to match your needs budget and taste here.Find the perfect postgraduate halls to match your needs budget and taste here.Postgraduate halls | SOASPlease note the accommodation application process for September 25/26 is not yet open.You can apply for accommodation once you have firmly accepted your offer of a place at SOAS. Please carefully read the guidelines onHow to apply for accommodation | SOASbefore submitting an application.

about: About CU Scarborough's state-of-the-art, purpose-built campus opened in September 2016. Students at CU Scarborough have access to all the facilities they need to support their studies and student life, all located in a modern, open-plan campus. At CU Scarborough, there is an emphasis on high levels of support for students, who are taught in small classes and have weekly tutorials in groups of no more than 5. Furthermore, international students have access to English lessons throughout the academic year as opposed to solely pre-sessional offered at comparing institutions. Tutors are also on hand for any additional support students may require. CU Scarborough is continuously expanding its courses, which means its building is ever-changing. The new £50m sport and education campus, which also features the Scarborough Sports Village and Flamingo Land Football Stadium, is home to the Scarborough Athletic Football Club. September 2018 saw the first cohort of Adult Nursing students begin their degree in the new clinical-skills lab and in September 2019 a brand new drama studio was opened to accommodate Acting students. CU Scarborough has gone from housing just 17 students in 2015, to over 600 students in 2019 and they are not stopping there! Why CU Scarborough Flexible Start Dates and Small Class Sizes: CU Scarborough aims to makes higher education accessible for international students by offering competitively-priced courses with numerous intakes throughout the year, small class sizes for higher levels of support, and ongoing English language support. Highly-ranked University: Shortlisted for University of the Year - The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2021. Teaching Excellence: Awarded Gold for Teaching and Learning Excellence by the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) 2017. Focus on Employability: CU Scarborough students are taught by lecturers who are experts in their field, making them career-ready with the skills to succeed upon graduation. 97% are employed or enrolled in further study within 6 months of graduation (DLHE survey, UG UK, 2016/17). Location: Scarborough is located on the beautiful North Yorkshire Coast with stunning scenery and glorious beaches. The growing town is rich with history and celebrates a wide variety of cultural and recreational activities (including festivals for surfing, science fiction, jazz music and more), making it a great student town for getting involved with the local community. about: About Ravensbourne University London is a specialist, industry-focused university on the vibrant Greenwich Peninsula collaborating with the creative industries to give their students the skills and opportunities they need to kick-start their careers. They have a community of approximately 2,600 students and offer practically focused digital media and design courses from pre-degree, undergraduate and postgraduate to professional short course level. Driven by industry standards and supported by the latest high-performance technology, they produce highly employable and enterprising graduates. Ravensbourne has a strong track record in graduate employability and business creation. Ravensbourne also hosts alongside its student community more than 100 creative technology businesses that utilise its leading edge technologies and media resources, and collaborate with its student body and industry partners. S tudents are professional creatives from the day they join the university. Ravensbourne works in close partnership with employers to foster the mindsets and skillsets that the creative industries need. Why Ravensbourne University London? Location : Ravensbourne is located at the heart of London’s newest permanent creative community on the Greenwich Peninsula. Thanks to recent investment, this stretch of London riverside has gone from marshy bog-land to a thriving public space, filled with creative businesses, a 3km art trail, restaurants, cafes, hotels and entertainment juggernaut, the O2 arena. Student Services : Ravensbourne supports its students, from specialist tutoring and mentoring, to counselling and career services. Campus Life : Students can expect plenty of events throughout the year both on and off campus, linked to campaigns such as Go Green Week, Fairtrade Fortnight, Children in Need, Sports Relief and Mental Health Day. Student Clubs : There are a range of clubs and societies to take part in including the Christian Union, LGBT+ Society, Film Society, Fencing Society, Asian Society, Latin Society, Trust in Dance, Product Design, Beauty Society and many, many more. about: About The University of Gloucestershire offers a wide range of degrees, courses and apprenticeships at undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Typically, students learn theory from industry experts and put their learning into practice in course work, real-world projects, placements and field trips. The school has a 150-year tradition of education dating back to 1847​. There are over 100 academic courses to choose from and approximately 10,000 students studying at the three campuses in Gloucestershire. ​​​​​Located in the heart of Gloucester, Oxstalls is just 15 minutes’ walk from the city centre giving students easy access to the city’s clubs, bars, shops, theatres, venues and cafes. Oxstalls is also just around the corner from Kingsholm rugby stadium, home to Gloucester Rugby and host to a number of Rugby World Cup matches in 2015. ​In 2018, the University of Gloucestershire's School of Business and Technology moved to the brand-new, state-of-the-art home at the Oxstalls campus. The £18 million development is home to the school's Business, Marketing, Human Resource Management, Law and Accounting and Finance courses. Why University of Gloucestershire Campus : Located in the heart of Gloucester, the students of Oxstalls benefit from connections to an extensive network of clubs, sports teams, theatres, festivals and venues. Student Life : Explore everything the university has to offer at Freshers' Fayre. This includes BBQs, fancy dress parties and the Freshers' Ball. The Freshers' Fayre is where students can sign up to clubs and societies - and get lots of freebies. Clubs : Get involved in anything of interest including snow club, ukulele, the Bee Project, film, comedy, creative writing, paintballing, Afro-Caribbean and Dumbledore's Army. Students can even start up their own. Athletics : Students who love sport will love Oxstalls' labs and facilities, including the onsite performance lab, strength and conditioning suite, sports therapy clinics, fitness suite, and the all-weather pitch. NOTE: This school may use UCAS as an external portal for application for some programs. A £20 (single application) or £25 (up to 5 applications) application fee may apply. Show More

about: About The Stoke-on-Trent campus is the main hub of University of Staffordshire - a modern and vibrant space located in the heart of a creative city. The campus has benefitted from significant investment in recent years, offering students an enhanced learning environment and a dynamic student experience. Guided tours, led by current student ambassadors, are available for prospective students and visitors. These provide valuable insight into life at the University and its state-of-the-art facilities. Why University of Staffordshire – Stoke-on-Trent campus Specialist facilities for real-world learning: At the Stoke-on-Trent campus, we’ve invested £2.2m in 12 immersive learning spaces, including a hospital ward, courtrooms, domestic living areas, custody suite and prison cell. It’s where students from a range of courses practise their skills in realistic environments. They could be treating a patient after a fall in the home, gathering and analysing forensic evidence, presenting legal arguments in court, or learning about offender management. Catalyst for the future: The Catalyst building is a landmark development at the heart of the campus. It brings together cutting-edge digital facilities, employer connections, and innovative learning spaces – providing a dynamic environment that prepares students for the workplace. A brand new Student Hub is also under construction, which will be a focal point for their student community. It will include social spaces, areas for student events and pop-up exhibitions, wellbeing activities, personal study areas, a prayer space and a base for student services. Supportive student life: The campus offers a range of wellbeing and academic support services, alongside a dedicated Students’ Union and on-site Sports Centre. Heritage and innovation: The University's presence in Stoke-on-Trent dates back to 1914, beginning with the historic Cadman Building. The campus continues to evolve, combining a strong sense of heritage with a forward-thinking approach to education, innovation and employability within the region. Show More

about: About At the University of South Wales, it’s all about being bold, independent and fulfilling potential. It is one of the largest universities in the UK, offering students excellent opportunities and prospects. South Wales is an exceptional part of the UK, with city life, countryside and coast. With campuses located in Cardiff, Newport, Pontypridd and Dubai, 95% of graduates work or study within six months of graduation (DLHE 2016/17). All of these campuses are easily reached by road, rail and air, so wherever students come from, they’re never far from home. A modern, ambitious university, the University of South Wales makes a real difference to the lives of students, staff and the communities which surround it. With campuses in Cardiff, Newport, Pontypridd and Dubai, the University is renowned for its partnerships with major employers. Their industry connections and emphasis on equipping students with real world experiences make their graduates among the most employable in the UK. And throughout everything they do, they strive to stay true to their core values of being Professional, Responsive, Inspiring and Creative. Why The University of South Wales Work Placements: Several courses offered at South Wales University guarantee work placements, while the Business and Management, Engineering, Computing and Science and Creative Industries faculties offer the opportunity to work in industry for a year. Study Abroad: ERASMUS+ is the European Union programme for training, youth and sport offering exciting opportunities for participants to study, work, volunteer, teach and train abroad. Employability: The University works hard to ensure that students are ready to start a successful career as soon as they graduate. They have even made employability part of the curriculum, with teaching informed by what happens in the real world and skills students will need for the workplace. High Quality Education: Many courses at the University have been accredited by professional bodies. This means they are of the highest standard and can grant students exemptions from professional exams as an added extra. Show More

about: About Greenwich is more than a collection of individual students and staff, it is a community of people united by their passion for learning. University of Greenwich courses will give you the skills employers value and the confidence to achieve extraordinary things. Our historic campuses in London and Kent offer first-class facilities, inspiring teaching and a friendly, diverse community. Greenwich employs well-qualified, expert teaching staff, the majority with formal teaching qualifications. A large number of our academics have also previously worked in business or industry. You'll benefit from excellent study facilities, including first-class advanced laboratories for science and engineering subjects and three campus libraries with dedicated academic services librarians. Why the University of Greenwich Beautiful, inspiring locations: The iconic Greenwich Maritime World Heritage Site receives millions of tourists each year who visit the Royal Observatory meridian line, Cutty Sark ship, historic market, museums and, of course, the ORNC. The campus can be seen in many movies including Skyfall and Pirates of the Caribbean, and TV series such as The Crown. Facilities to shape your future: Since 2013, the university has invested more than £150 million in laboratories, teaching spaces and student facilities. Advancing knowledge at Greenwich: Research addresses some of the world's most challenging issues, from global health to public safety. Current investigations include mosquito-carried diseases, such as malaria and the Zika virus, and the use of 3D printers for medical implants. Other projects include life-saving research into evacuating difficult environments, such as high-rise construction sites, and understanding the links between politics and the economy. Taught by passionate people: Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) Silver rating in 2017 and Higher Education Academy National Teaching Fellowships for a large number of our teaching staff. Show More

top_disciplines: Law, Politics, Social, Community Service and Teaching
about: About For those looking for the bustle of city life without the hustle, beautiful Kingston upon Thames is the place to be. On the doorstep of the capital, Kingston is one of London’s safest boroughs and offers all the highlights of city living in a leafy, riverside location. Kingston upon Thames in Greater London is just 10 miles from the centre of the capital. The University has roots going back more than 120 years to the Kingston Technical Institute which opened in 1899. Kingston University takes great pride in the difference they make in the lives of their over 18,000 students and the wider community they serve. They are constantly striving to provide excellent services and continue to make a positive contribution to the economic, social, and cultural life of the borough. Why Kingston University London - Kingston Hill Location: Kingston Upon Thames has an excellent public transportation system, with two mainline train stations, bus routes and major motorways nearby, making it easy to get around the city and country. Kingston Hill is a beautiful, leafy, self-contained site with a mix of modern and historic buildings and a community feel. Located within easy reach of the town centre, Kingston Hill can be reached easily by public transport. Extracurricular Activities: There is no shortage of clubs, societies and volunteer organizations to join that bring people of common interests, faiths and ethnic backgrounds together. Facilities: The Kingston Hill campus boasts a cafe, restaurant and bar as well as halls of residence, tennis courts, table-tennis tables and an outdoor fitness trail. The learning resources centre includes a cafe, group learning rooms and bookable meeting pods. Kingston Business School has a modern, purpose-built building, with some of the best facilities for business-based courses in the country, including a new business incubation space, Kingston Business Innovation Centre. The Frank Lampl building also has a wide range of practical facilities, simulations suites, lecture theatres and teaching spaces for health and social care students. The campus is also home to the Visconti studio (created with legendary record producer Tony Visconti), a large performance studio, five recording studios and two Mac labs. Accommodation: The University offers international students a range of high quality halls to choose from, all of which have single-study bedrooms arranged in flats with self-catering kitchens. about: About Oxford International Pathway College - London is a level 3 pathway college offering international students one-year pre-university foundation courses designed to provide them with an entry route to university in the UK. OIPC - London provides small class sizes for individual support, a diverse student community, experience teachers and support staff, and a focus on ensuring the student has the course material and support they need to progress to one of Oxford International's many progression universities! Some of these include: University of Greenwich Coventry University Ravensbourne University Staffordshire University The University of Central Lancashire University for the Creative Arts University of Bristol University of Essex and more! Why Oxford International Pathway College - London Central location : OIPC - London is located just 15 minutes away from London's city centre! Campus facilities: Students will be taught at Oxford International's school in London Greenwich and will have full access to all resources offered by Greenwich University. This includes the Student’s Union, Counselling Centre, Student Advice Service, and student clubs. Students will also have access to the extensive library services on Stockwell Street, part of the University of Greenwich. Academic and progression support : The support team is always available to help students wherever they are on their learning journey. From practical advice to more intensive support – to make their time at the London Centre run as smoothly as possible. Additionally, Greenwich’s online Academic Skills Centre can help students improve their essay writing, research skills, presentation and exam techniques and any additional study skills they may need. Students will also have access to one-to-one tutorials with academic skills tutors and workshop sessions with subject librarians. All workshops are free and run throughout term time. Guaranteed progression : Once they have completed the course successfully (meeting all progression requirements), students will continue onto the next stage of their chosen degree course at university. about: About Study for a degree from one of the UK’s leading universities in an inspirational setting! CU Coventry, part of the Coventry University Group, offers a style of education that is flexible and designed to fit around students' lives. Students can choose from a wide range of vocational, career-focused courses and study at a pace that suits them . CU Coventry students benefit from a modern, forward-thinking higher education institution, reinforced by the quality and reputation of Coventry University. All courses are awarded and accredited by Coventry University, which means that students receive a Coventry University qualification upon graduation. In March 2019, Coventry opened its state-of-the-art £33m campus in the city to enhance the university's innovative education model and provide students with a cutting-edge learning environment. The building has been designed to enable collaboration, creativity and innovation to flourish and features teaching rooms, IT suites, engineering and science labs, a moot court and café, as well as extensive breakout areas for social learning to make teaching more flexible. Why CU Coventry Flexible Start Dates and Small Class Sizes: CU Coventry aims to makes higher education accessible for international students by offering competitively-priced courses with numerous intakes throughout the year, small class sizes for higher levels of support, and ongoing English language support. Highly-ranked University: Shortlisted for University of the Year - The Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide 2021. Teaching Excellence: Awarded Gold for Teaching and Learning Excellence by the Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) 2017. Focus on Employability: CU Coventry students are taught by lecturers who are experts in their field, making them career-ready with the skills to succeed upon graduation. 97% are employed or enrolled in further study within 6 months of graduation (DLHE survey, UG UK, 2016/17). Location: Coventry is a vibrant and diverse student city, located in the center of the UK and only 1 hour from London by train. The city’s rich history and heritage sees world famous sites like Coventry Cathedral and St Mary’s Guildhall sit alongside exciting newer developments like Coventry Transport Museum, Fargo Village and a host of shops, restaurants, entertainment and nightlife venues. about: About University of Brighton is a progressive, modern school in one of Britain's most exciting, lively cities. It is career-focused with excellent facilities and business connections and, at its heart, it is an inventive institution with a creative spirit. The university offers degrees in a variety of subjects and its main campus, Moulsecoomb, is home to programs in applied sciences, architecture, business, law, and engineering. Over the last few years, this inspiring campus has undergone a significant transformation, and now features new residence halls and learning facilities, fitness and student union facilities, numerous green spaces, and an accessible pedestrian bridge that links both sides of campus. A big part of the academic culture at University of Brighton is about unlocking each student's potential by empowering them to do something they really love and succeed at it. Degrees at Brighton are generally quite flexible, and students are often can choose optional modules, work placements and volunteering opportunities that work to their strengths. Why University of Brighton? Campus: Brighton's community is made up of students and staff from over 150 countries. There are more than 100 societies for students to expand their interests, meet like-minded people, and do something they love. Facilities: The university has 4 campuses, all with superb facilities, including sports halls, a swimming pool, dance studios, a newsroom, Psychology labs, world-class Design Archives, and more! Location: Brighton is a student-friendly, artistic, and bustling city with famous beaches and a diverse and inclusive community. It has an abundance of stores, green spaces, restaurants, bars, and entertainment options, and is a short train ride from London. Placement Opportunities: An important part of many programs at Brighton is the opportunity for students to gain work or volunteer experience in a professional environment. Professional Accreditation : The majority of students study programs that are accredited by professional and statutory bodies. Successful completion of a professionally accredited course indicates that the student has reached the occupational standard required to practice that profession. Show More

about: About Glasgow Caledonian University London is a postgraduate university campus of Glasgow Caledonian University (GCU), located in an ultra-modern environment in the heart of London. The campus offers a unique range of MBA and MSc courses, high-quality teaching and links with international businesses. GCU London provides students with an enriching and diverse learning experience underpinned by a vibrant international, intellectual and cultural life. The university attracts students from over 56 countries, from a range of backgrounds from all corners of the world. GCU London is committed to delivering a high-quality student experience through award-winning support services, and promotes employability and global citizenship in their graduates. GCU London is ideally situated a short walk from Liverpool Street station with a range of accommodation is available close to the campus. Why Glasgow Caledonian University London Campus: GCU London has a diverse student community and offers globally-recognized courses based on the University's close links with industry. Facilities: The university provides a leading-edge learning environment, harnessing the latest technologies and offering modern teaching space for lectures, small-group study, and social learning. Location : Voted the world's premier student city (QS Best Student Cities 2019), London is home to international students from all over the world who are looking to learn new things, meet new people, and further their careers. Located in Spitalfields, GCU London is in close proximity to the capital’s internationally-renowned financial and fashion industries. British School of Fashion : At the forefront of Fashion Business Education in the UK, GCU London offers specialized postgraduate programs in the business of fashion with the mission is to develop a new generation of fashion and luxury business leaders and innovators. Career-Focused Education : GCU London believes that "careers come first," ensuring degrees are career-focused with opportunities to undertake an internship or placement, volunteer, study abroad or take part in consultancy. Industry experts also deliver a suite of masterclasses at the university. Industry-Informed Courses: Course content is informed by the very latest cotemporary academic research and designed with the support of industry leaders. Show More

features.answer: Post Graduation Permit29 out of 29 programs are eligible for Post-Study Work Visa.Post-Study Work Visa will be open to all students, on Tier 4 visas, who are accepted onto a course in the 2020 intake or later. Once you have successfully completed a course of study at the undergraduate level or above at an approved UK Higher Education Provider you would be able to stay and work (in any sector or at any level) for a maximum of two years.The full details and requirements are yet to be announced by the UK Government, but will be updated here when made available.Co-op/Internship ParticipationCooperative education (or co-operative education) and internships are methods of combining classroom-based education with practical work experience. about: About Part of Northeastern University’s Global Campus Network and overlooking the River Thames and Tower Bridge, Northeastern University London (NU London) offers academically challenging educational programmes designed to inspire innovative thinking, encourage interdisciplinary study, and provide global experiences, while equipping students with the advanced skills and experiences that are highly sought by employers and society. Why Northeastern University London : Accessible Campus : The entire campus is extremely welcoming to all, with excellent accessibility and support, including lifts, wide entry points, adaptable furniture, and hearing loops. The ventilation and air-filtration system is similar to those used in hospital settings providing enhanced protection for the community. Location : Devon House is situated at the heart of historic St Katharine Docks, just a few minutes’ walk from the Tower of London and Tower Bridge and enjoys stunning river views with terraces and open areas surrounded by dozens of restaurants, cafes, bars, and a leisure marina, all part of a dynamic waterside setting. The location is also right on the doorstep of the City, London’s Central Business District, a worldwide centre for commerce. Home to the Stock Exchange and the Bank of England, as well as finance and commerce sectors, the law profession, cultural organisations, creative industries, tech companies and start-ups. The City offers a wide range of opportunities for work experience, internships, and part-time student employment.The University is also just minutes from East London Tech City, a cluster of high-tech companies and web businesses.Devon House is the focal point for our stimulating and diverse international community, with Northeastern University London and Northeastern University students sharing facilities. Show More
